extraction.name: TOFU: A Task of Fictitious Unlearning for LLMs
extraction.description: A benchmark for evaluating the efficacy of unlearning methods in large language models.
extraction.creator: Pratyush Maini, Zhili Feng, Avi Schwarzschild, Zachary C. Lipton, J. Zico Kolter
extraction.citeAs: TOFU: A Task of Fictitious Unlearning for LLMs
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The TOFU dataset consists of 200 fictitious author profiles, each with 20 question-answer pairs, generated using GPT-4.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: The raw data was generated using GPT-4 with a generic prompt, then refined with a seeded prompt to minimize biases.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: The dataset was curated to ensure that the generated data does not leak biases from the pretraining data of LLMs.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Annotations were created by generating question-answer pairs based on predefined attributes of fictitious authors.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: The annotations were analyzed to ensure that they did not leak biases from the pretraining data.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The dataset is released on Hugging Face and can be accessed for research purposes.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset aims to simulate a practical scenario for the Right to be Forgotten in the context of LLMs.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset was designed to minimize biases from the pretraining data of LLMs.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset is limited to entity-level unlearning and does not cover instance-level unlearning or behavior-level unlearning.
